comments.content: The overridden FailCondition duplicates the base ModSuddenDeath logic (`result.Type.AffectsCombo() && !result.IsHit`) instead of delegating to `base.FailCondition(...)`. If the base implementation changes, this override will silently diverge. Prefer: `return (SliderTailMiss.Value && result.HitObject is SliderTailCircle && result.Type == HitResult.IgnoreMiss) || base.FailCondition(healthProcessor, result);`
